credentialFields.label: Trading account id
credentialFields.help: The numeric account id OpenD reports for the account to trade. Leave blank when the moomoo login has a single US or Hong Kong securities account; it is required when there are several.

credentialFields.label: Trade password
credentialFields.help: Unlocks live trading on a command-line OpenD. Only its MD5 hash is sent, and only to OpenD. Leave blank for a paper account, or when you unlock trading in the OpenD window yourself — the window build does not accept an unlock over the API.

credentialFields.label: Environment
credentialFields.help: real for a live account (the default), paper for moomoo's paper-trading account on the same login.

sandbox.notes: moomoo paper trading runs through the same OpenD as a live account rather than a separate endpoint: link with environment 'paper'. The Paper connector (id 'paper') implements the same contract for rehearsal without OpenD.

compliance.notes: moomoo requires the API questionnaire and agreements to be completed at the first OpenD login before any request is served. US pattern-day-trader rules apply to US margin accounts under USD 25,000. Live trading must be unlocked in OpenD, and one unlock serves every connection to that OpenD.
